about: Fixed music briefs for the local music spike: four film-score cues and one song, the same for every model.

cues.name: tense
cues.caption: Tense cinematic underscore for a night scene: low string ostinato, pulsing synth bass, sparse metallic percussion, minor key, slowly building, instrumental

cues.name: warm
cues.caption: Calm, melancholic folk instrumental for a film score: solo acoustic guitar and soft cello, slow tempo, sea at dawn

cues.name: action
cues.caption: Driving action cue for a chase: taiko drums, staccato strings, short brass hits, fast and relentless, instrumental

cues.name: ambient
cues.caption: Ambient bed under dialogue: slow evolving synth pads, distant felt piano notes, calm and spacious, no drums, instrumental

cues.name: song
cues.caption: Melancholic indie pop ballad, female vocal, piano and soft brushed drums, intimate and warm
cues.lyrics:
[Verse]
The ferry leaves at seven
The harbour lights go dim
I kept your coat beside me
And waited by the rim

[Chorus]
So call me from the water
Say the tide will bring you home
I'll leave the porch light burning
So you never sail alone
